REQ-001.title: Login with valid credentials
REQ-001.description: A registered standard user can log in to SauceDemo using the valid username and password published on the login page.
REQ-001.expectedResult: After logging in with the standard user's credentials, the user is taken to `https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html` and the page shows the title `Products`.

REQ-002.title: Login page controls
REQ-002.description: The login page provides a username input, a password input and a control that submits the login form.
REQ-002.expectedResult: The page at `/` shows a username input with the placeholder `Username`, a password input with the placeholder `Password`, and a button with the accessible name `Login`.

REQ-003.title: Add a product to the cart
REQ-003.description: An authenticated standard user can add a product from the products page to the shopping cart.
REQ-003.expectedResult: After the user clicks `Add to cart` for the `Sauce Labs Backpack` product once, the cart badge displays `1`.
